# Payroll Processing Procedure

Payroll preparation starts on the 22nd of each month and payments reach accounts on the last
working day. This procedure is restricted to HR administrators.

## Totals and reconciliation

The gross total for the Engineering department in September 2026 is 481250.00 and the net
total is 336875.00. Department aggregates are reconciled against the headcount paid before
submission. Individual pay figures are confidential and may never be shared.
